tldr: Aug 9 morning batch: education pushed back on AI cheating — Denmark now requires oral defenses for all take-home written work, the clearest assessment-redesign move yet. Amazon's data-center buildout is on track to become the single biggest pollution source in the US as AI compute demand surges. A 2,500-person study found readers can't distinguish AI short stories from human ones — until they're told a machine wrote them. On tooling: Claude Code sessions can now message each other and share context across parallel terminals, YC open-sourced its internal QM multi-agent harness, and Tencent's Hy3 went global under Apache 2.0, topping OpenRouter's usage leaderboard within a week of release.
